import re

with open("/app/regex.txt") as f:
    pattern = f.read().strip()

print("Pattern:", repr(pattern))
print()

# Test cases
test_cases = [
    # Line with IPv4 and one date - should match the date
    ("2024-01-15 192.168.1.1 - connection established", "2024-01-15"),
    # Line with IPv4 and multiple dates - should match last date
    ("2024-01-15 192.168.1.1 - processed 2024-02-20", "2024-02-20"),
    # Line without IPv4 - should not match
    ("2024-01-15 - no IP address here", None),
    # Invalid IPv4 (leading zeros) - should not match
    ("2024-01-15 192.168.01.1 - leading zero", None),
    # Invalid date format in user ID - should not match
    ("user 1134-12-1234 - no IP", None),
    # Valid edge cases
    ("2024-02-29 10.0.0.1 - leap year", "2024-02-29"),
    ("2024-12-31 255.255.255.255 - max values", "2024-12-31"),
    # Multiple dates with IPv4
    ("2023-01-01 192.168.0.1 event 2023-06-15 2023-12-31", "2023-12-31"),
    # Date at end of line with IPv4
    ("10.0.0.1 - log entry 2024-03-15", "2024-03-15"),
]

for text, expected in test_cases:
    matches = re.findall(pattern, text, re.MULTILINE)
    result = matches[0] if matches else None
